nodes_add.name: Thycaud Ayyavu Swamikal
nodes_add.note: Tamil-born yogi in Thiruvananthapuram; taught hatha yoga to Chattampi Swamikal and Narayana Guru.

nodes_add.name: Kummampilli Raman Pillai Asan
nodes_add.note: Sanskrit scholar of central Travancore who taught Narayana Guru from about 1877.

nodes_add.name: Dr P. Palpu
nodes_add.note: Ezhava physician; organiser of the SNDP Yogam (1903); father of Nataraja Guru.

nodes_add.name: Kumaran Asan
nodes_add.note: Malayalam poet and disciple of Narayana Guru; first general secretary of the SNDP Yogam.

nodes_add.name: Nataraja Guru
nodes_add.note: Disciple of Narayana Guru; founded the Narayana Gurukula in 1923; commentator on his works.

nodes_add.name: Guru Nitya Chaitanya Yati
nodes_add.note: Disciple of Nataraja Guru; author of That Alone, a commentary on the Atmopadesa Satakam.

nodes_update.name: Sree Narayana Guru
nodes_update.note: Birth year given as 1854, 1855 or 1856 in different sources; 1854 follows Britannica and Nataraja Guru's chronology.

nodes_update.name: Chattampi Swamikal
nodes_update.note: Born Ayyappan (Kunjan), 25 August 1853; died Panmana, 5 May 1924.

edges_upsert.note: Lifelong companions and fellow students of Thycaud Ayyavu; some of Chattampi's admirers call him Narayana Guru's guru, which Narayana Guru's followers reject.
Taught him yoga; Kerala Tourism says Ayyavu formally accepted him as a disciple on a Chitra Pournami day.
Taught him hatha yoga and Shaiva mantras.
Murugan devotion (Shanmukhadasa), Tamil and Siddha learning.
Single meeting at Arunachala in 1916; no evidence that either changed the other's teaching. Draw dotted.
SNDP Yogam, founded 15 May 1903 with the Guru as president.

places.name: Aruvippuram
places.what: Shiva consecration on the Neyyar, Shivaratri 1888

glossary.def: Malayalam for core, embryo or mould; Narayana Guru's word for the one source from which knower and known both arise.
Malayalam for knowledge or awareness; in Narayana Guru, the one consciousness that appears as knower, known and knowing.
Birth group: both 'species' and 'caste'. Narayana Guru argued that humans are one jati because they share one form and one way of birth.
A wandering ascetic who has dropped social and ritual rules.

narayana-guru: Birth 28 Aug 1855, parents Madan Asan and Kuttiyamma, Raman Pillai Asan of Puthuppally Varanappally, Kaliamma, 8 years Pillathadam cave, SNDP 15 May 1903 -> https://sngm.org/sree-narayana-guru/
Birth 20 Aug 1854?, wife died a few years later, Aluva 1914, mother died 1872 -> https://www.britannica.com/print/article/403430

Chronology: 1877 Karunagappalli; 1897 Atmopadesa Satakam at Aruvippuram; 1913 Aluva; 1921 brotherhood conference; 1924 all-religions conference, Brahma Vidya Mandiram -> https://sngm.org/index.php/guru/life-of-guru/biographi-of-narayana-guru
Aruvippuram midnight, 3 am, 'We consecrated our Shiva' -> https://www.keralatourism.org/sreenarayanaguru/temple-concept/aruvippuram-siva-temple
Perunnelli, P.K. Krishnan Vaidyar; Maruthwamala; Ayyavu accepted Nanu -> https://www.keralatourism.org/sreenarayanaguru/life/guruvaryan
1916 Ramana visit, Palani Swami, Nirvrtti Pancakam, Darsanamala verses, Ramana quote -> https://archive.arunachala.org/docs/nirvrtti-pancakam
Tagore 15 Nov 1922, C.F. Andrews, visitors' book quote -> https://thesouthfirst.com/kerala/lunatic-asylum-to-gods-abode-when-tagore-met-narayana-guru-in-keralas-sivagiri-100-years-ago/
Gandhi disagreed at Aluva, came round by 1937 -> https://www.keralatourism.org/sreenarayanaguru/meetings

'Whatever the religion...' 1923 with Sahodaran Ayyappan; 1924 conference; 'Not to argue and win' -> https://www.keralatourism.org/sreenarayanaguru/message/whatever-religion-good-man-argue-to-know-and-inform

Murukkumpuzha prabha; Kalavancode June 1927; schools over temples -> https://www.keralatourism.org/sreenarayanaguru/temple-concept/murukkumpuzha-sree-kalakanteswara-temple-kalayancode-mirror-consecration
Verse 44, Jati Mimamsa, Aruvippuram verse translations -> https://gurunarayanalokam.com/guru-wisdom/narayana-guru-by-vinaya-chaitanya.html
Daiva Dasakam believed 1914, Sivagiri orphans -> https://natarajaguru.org/?p=13058
BJP Facebook post 16 Sept 2016; Pinarayi Vijayan reply -> https://swarajyamag.com/amp/story/culture%2Fsree-narayana-guru-was-anything-but-non-hindu
chattampi-swamikal: Born 25 Aug 1853 Kannammoola; Nambudiri father, Nair mother; Pettayil Raman Pillai Asan; Sundaram Pillai; Shanmukhadasa; avadhuta at Vadaveeswaram; disciples 1893, 1898; died Panmana 5 May 1924; Vedadhikara 1899/1920; 33 works -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chattampi_Swamikal

Sanskrit by overhearing; Sudra; inter-dining; dogs; Kochavu Vaidyar/Sahodaran; books; samadhi verse by Narayana Guru; mixed legacy -> https://deccanchronicle.com/lifestyle/viral-and-trending/250817/varied-legacies-of-chattamby-swamikal.html
